title: Peppa Pig
description: English dubbing scenes from Peppa Pig.
author: Parrotbook

scenes.title: 你一直坐在眼镜上！
quotes: Daddy Pig, you were sitting on them all the time!
猪爸爸，你一直坐在眼镜上！
Oh!
哦！
Silly Daddy!
糊涂爸爸！
I don't know how they got there.
我不知道眼镜怎么跑到那里了。

scenes.title: 猜猜我们干什么了！
scenes.english: Guess what we have been doing!
quotes: Daddy, Daddy! Guess what we've been doing!
爸爸，爸爸！猜猜我们干什么了！
Let me think. Have you been watching television?
让我想想。你们在看电视吗？
No, no, Daddy.
不，不是，爸爸。
Have you just had a bath?
你们刚洗完澡吗？
No, no.
不，不是。
I know! You've been jumping in muddy puddles!
我知道了！你们在泥坑里跳来跳去！
Yes, yes, Daddy! We've been jumping in muddy puddles!
对，对，爸爸！我们在泥坑里跳来跳去！

scenes.title: 我们帮你找眼镜好吗？
scenes.english: Can we help find your glasses?
quotes: Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
一定有人把我的眼镜放到什么地方了。
Do you remember where you last put them, Daddy Pig?
猪爸爸，你记得上次把眼镜放在哪里了吗？
When I don't wear them, I always put them in my pocket. But they aren't there now.
不戴的时候，我总把眼镜放在口袋里。可是现在不在里面。
Daddy, can we help find your glasses?
爸爸，我们帮你找眼镜好吗？
Good idea, Peppa. If you find them, Daddy will stop being so grumpy.
好主意，佩奇。找到眼镜，爸爸就不会这么暴躁了。
I'm not grumpy!
我才没有暴躁呢！

scenes.title: 病人可以有访客吗？
scenes.english: Can the patient have a visitor?
quotes: Oh no! What's wrong with George?
哦，不！乔治怎么了？
Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game.
别担心，爸爸。我们只是在玩游戏。
George is our patient.
乔治是我们的病人。
Oh, I see. Can the patient have a visitor?
哦，我明白了。病人可以有访客吗？
Just for a little while. He might get tired.
只能一小会儿。他可能会累的。
Cookies!
饼干！
Yes, they're for George. They're his medicine to make him feel better.
对，给乔治的。这是让他好起来的药。

scenes.title: 那是恐龙吗？
quotes: Is that a dinosaur?
那是恐龙吗？
It's just a toy dinosaur.
那只是一只玩具恐龙。
Grr! Dinosaur!
吼！恐龙！
Brilliant!
太棒了！
What?
什么？
Dinosaur! Grr!
恐龙！吼！
Dinosaur! Grr!
恐龙！吼！
Really scary!
真吓人！
That's brilliant!
太棒了！

scenes.title: 煎饼飞得太高啦！
quotes: Is everyone watching?
大家都在看吗？
The secret of making a good pancake is to flip it high into the air.
做出好煎饼的秘诀，就是把它高高地翻到空中。
A-one, two, three, hoopla!
一、二、三，嘿！
Silly Daddy!
傻爸爸！
Oh, maybe that was just a bit too high.
哦，可能刚才翻得有点太高了。
Oh, what a shame. That was the last pancake.
哦，真可惜，那是最后一张煎饼了。
It should be a simple matter to get it down.
把它弄下来应该很简单。

scenes.title: 再给乔治一次机会
quotes: George found me! Now it's Daddy's turn to hide.
乔治找到我啦！现在轮到爸爸藏起来了。
Oh, I think George should have another turn.
哦，我觉得应该让乔治再来一次。
But George isn't very good at hiding.
可是乔治不太会藏。
I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
我相信这次他会藏得更好。闭上眼睛，开始数数吧。
